data.description:
As a maintainer, I want a single always-runs, fail-closed `review-gate` summary check on every base==main PR so that the conjunction of independently-skippable required checks is replaced by one gate that cannot report success without per-SHA review coverage.

Plan refs: A-4.5; §2.6 (REDESIGN); §2.9/§2.10 (shared ticket-exemption helper). THE ARCHITECTURAL CORE. Ship in warn/advisory first and shadow-observe on live PR2 traffic.

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1: a single script `review-gate` (NOT a needs/if:failure() aggregation — that greens on a skipped upstream) runs on every base==main PR with no code_changed skip. (SC1)
- DD2: it fails-closed unless every SHA in origin/main..head is proven reviewed by the per-SHA review-coverage-invariant, EXCEPT SHAs whose diff is entirely within the event-sourced ticket store (.tickets-tracker tree) via a shared rc_diff_is_tickets_only helper. The exemption is diff-scoped tree evidence ONLY (git diff-tree non-empty AND every entry anchored to the ticket-store prefix) — never a trailer/marker (v4 fabricated-trailer lesson); empty file list = NOT exempt. (SC1/SC4)
- DD3: the shared rc_diff_is_tickets_only helper lives in one place (review-coverage-lib.sh, sourced by all three consumers) and is wired into review-coverage-invariant.sh, verify-session-provenance.sh, AND fp-recovery-audit-sweep.sh (the last has no clean-merge scaffolding today — build it). Each consumer honors its own error posture; the predicate is identical. (SC4)
- DD4: it runs the dangling-references check inline (same script) so it cannot independently skip-to-success, and replaces the no-op merge-pipeline-checks umbrella as the always-runs gate. (SC1)
- DD5: it fail-closes on precondition with bounded retry (story 2 ledger) and reconciles with assert-review-liveness.sh (does NOT re-implement liveness's classification cross-check; complementary, boundary documented). (SC1)
- DD6: a single shared-fixture EQUIVALENCE TEST asserts all three ticket-exemption consumers return identical exempt/not-exempt verdicts (the trailer-shortcut survived in one path after removal from another — prevent the same divergence).

LIVE VERIFICATION + EXPERIMENTS (warn mode):
- E2: allowlisted-only PR2 with un-reviewed content -> review-gate would BLOCK (logs FAIL in warn).
- E3: confirm merge-pipeline-checks no-ops on staged-* head and review-gate is the real always-runs gate.
- E8: populated staged-* merge-commit: clean merge -> exempt (no false wedge); evil merge (manual edit in merge commit) -> RED.
- E14/E15 across all three consumers: ticket-only -> exempt; mixed ticket+code -> NOT exempt (no launder); clean merge -> exempt. Identical verdicts.
- E13: confirm a skipped upstream does NOT green the gate (single-script property).
- Shadow-observe several real PR2 promotions in warn mode; review-gate's warn verdict must match the actual outcome with zero false BLOCKs.

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: if review-gate in warn mode would FALSE-BLOCK any legitimate PR2 (clean, fully-reviewed, or ticket-only), STOP and fix before story 6/7 — a false-wedge under enforce blocks the team. If the three consumers ever disagree on an exemption verdict, STOP (launder/wedge risk).

Maps to SC1, SC4. DEPENDS ON stories 1 (fail-closed), 2 (ledger), 4 (dangling matcher).
